ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Animals ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Weather ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Water ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Soil ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. A — Glucose and oxygen

3. D — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. C — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

6. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.

7. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

8. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.

9. B — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

10. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.

11. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

12. A — Ice melting to water
